quips.jaymoskingdoms.town_fool.0: Town fool, come hence, if thou value thy life.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.what_monster.0: What manner of monster be this?
quips.jaymoskingdoms.trickery.0: Thy trickery cannot pierce mine armour.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.cleave.0: 'Tis time to cleave our enemies in twain.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.unarmoured.0: Thou goest unarmoured? Bold, or simple. I cannot tell which.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.worse_shot.0: Thou art a worse shot than thou art a hero.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.fare_well.0: Fare thee well, armourless one. Try not to die before supper.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.hold_stranger.0: Hold, stranger. Thy face is unknown to me, and I like it not.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.squire_or_fool.0: Either thou art training to be my squire, or thou art the town fool.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.pain.0: For thy sake, I hope thou hast a high threshold for pain. For mine, I hope thou hast not.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.fight_beside.0: Though they fear me, I must guard this town. Wilt thou fight beside me?
quips.jaymoskingdoms.all_medieval.0: And down it goes. We have gone all medieval upon it.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.web.0: Watch thyself! Let it not tag thee with its web.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.justice.0: No foe escapeth the arrow of justice!
quips.jaymoskingdoms.horse_wit.0: Mine horse hath more wit than thee, and he is a horse.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.speak_plain.0: Speak plain, knave, or speak not at all.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.goblin_smell.0: By my troth, thou smellest of goblin.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.crowd.0: When the crowd flees one way, a true knight rides the other.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.witch.0: Art thou certain thou'rt no witch?
quips.jaymoskingdoms.science.0: Magic? Where I come from, we call it science.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.thing_on_wall.0: A thing upon the wall, in broad daylight? Fetch the priest.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.eight_legs.0: Another eight-legged knave. They breed like sins.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.beyond_reckoning.0: 'Twas monstrous before. Now 'tis a beast beyond all reckoning.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.back_lest.0: Back, lest I be forced to harm thee.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.touched.0: Art thou touched in the head? None may strike a monster of such size head-on!
quips.jaymoskingdoms.face_fears.0: Thou hast taught us to face our fears. We shall not forget thee.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.stranger_day.0: By my troth, this day could not be stranger.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.still_hero.0: Rise, friend. Thou art still a hero.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.my_tone.0: My words make no sense to thee, but from my tone, thou hast reason to worry.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.mirror.0: They say a knight once came out of a mirror, swearing he was another man's own self. The ale was strong that night.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.no_fool.0: Art thou sure that one is no fool? I am not.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.robes.0: Listen to me. I am not evil. They made strong robes in mine day, that is all.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.ceiling_torch.0: By what sorcery doth this small torch upon the ceiling shine forth?
quips.jaymoskingdoms.ceiling_torch.1: A bulb of light. What an ingenious incantation.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.one_knight.0: Fine plate. But there can be but one knight in this company, and I am he.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.flee.0: Thou art sore hurt. Shall we flee? ... Nay. I see we flee not.
quips.jaymoskingdoms.what_form.0: By my troth! What manner of beast hast thou become?
